verses.greek: Σκιὰν γὰρ ἔχων ὁ νόμος τῶν μελλόντων ἀγαθῶν, οὐκ αὐτὴν τὴν εἰκόνα τῶν πραγμάτων, κατʼ ἐνιαυτὸν ταῖς αὐταῖς θυσίαις ἃς προσφέρουσιν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς οὐδέποτε δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους τελειῶσαι·
verses.literal: A shadow for having the law of the coming good things not themselves the form of the things each year with the same sacrifices which they offer to the continuous never is able those drawing near to perfect
verses.dgt: For since the law has a shadow of the good things to come, not the very image of the realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices continually offered year after year, perfect those who approach.

verses.greek: ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἂν ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι, διὰ τὸ μηδεμίαν ἔχειν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν τοὺς λατρεύοντας ἅπαξ κεκαθαρισμένους;
verses.literal: Otherwise not would they have ceased being offered because of the none having any longer conscience of sins those serving once cleansed!
verses.dgt: Otherwise, would they not have ceased being offered, because the worshipers, once cleansed, would no longer have consciousness of sins?

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ἐν αὐταῖς ἀνάμνησις ἁμαρτιῶν κατʼ ἐνιαυτόν,
verses.literal: But in these there is a reminder of sins every year
verses.dgt: But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of sins year after year,

verses.greek: ἀδύνατον γὰρ αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων ἀφαιρεῖν ἁμαρτίας.
verses.literal: Impossible it is indeed for the blood of bulls and of goats to take away sins.
verses.dgt: for it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

verses.greek: διὸ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον λέγει· Θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας, σῶμα δὲ κατηρτίσω μοι·
verses.literal: Therefore coming into the world He says: Sacrifice and offering not You have desired a body however You have prepared me
verses.dgt: Therefore, when he comes into the world, he says, “Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me.

verses.greek: ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ εὐδόκησας.
verses.literal: Burnt offerings and offerings for sin not You have delighted in
verses.dgt: In burnt offerings and offerings for sin you took no pleasure.

verses.greek: τότε εἶπον· Ἰδοὺ ἥκω, ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ, τοῦ ποιῆσαι, ὁ θεός, τὸ θέλημά σου.
verses.literal: Then I said Behold I have come — in the scroll of the book it has been written of Me — the to do O God the will of You.
verses.dgt: Then I said, ‘Look, I have come—in the scroll of the book it is written about me—to do your will, O God.’”

verses.greek: ἀνώτερον λέγων ὅτι Θυσίας καὶ προσφορὰς καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ἠθέλησας οὐδὲ εὐδόκησας, αἵτινες κατὰ νόμον προσφέρονται,
verses.literal: Above saying that sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and offerings for sin not You have desired nor You delighted in which according to Law are offered
verses.dgt: After saying above, “Sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and offerings for sin you did not desire nor take pleasure in”—which are offered according to the law—

verses.greek: τότε εἴρηκεν· Ἰδοὺ ἥκω τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου· ἀναιρεῖ τὸ πρῶτον ἵνα τὸ δεύτερον στήσῃ.
verses.literal: then He has said Behold I have come the to do of the will of You. He takes away the first that the second He may establish
verses.dgt: then he has said, “Look, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first in order to establish the second.

verses.greek: ἐν ᾧ θελήματι ἡγιασμένοι ἐσμὲν διὰ τῆς προσφορᾶς τοῦ σώματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐφάπαξ.
verses.literal: By that will sanctified we are through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.dgt: By that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

verses.greek: Καὶ πᾶς μὲν ἱερεὺς ἕστηκεν καθʼ ἡμέραν λειτουργῶν καὶ τὰς αὐτὰς πολλάκις προσφέρων θυσίας, αἵτινες οὐδέποτε δύνανται περιελεῖν ἁμαρτίας.
verses.literal: And every indeed priest has stood every day ministering and the same repeatedly offering sacrifices which never are able to take away sins
verses.dgt: And every priest stands day after day serving and offering repeatedly the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

verses.greek: οὗτος δὲ μίαν ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν προσενέγκας θυσίαν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.literal: This One however one for sins having offered sacrifice in the perpetuity sat down at the right hand the of God
verses.dgt: But this one, having offered one sacrifice for sins for all time, sat down at the right hand of God,

verses.greek: τὸ λοιπὸν ἐκδεχόμενος ἕως τεθῶσιν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ,
verses.literal: the henceforth awaiting until may be placed the enemies of Him as a footstool for the feet of Him.
verses.dgt: waiting from then on until his enemies are made a footstool for his feet.

verses.greek: μιᾷ γὰρ προσφορᾷ τετελείωκεν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς τοὺς ἁγιαζομένους.
verses.literal: By one for offering He has perfected for the all time those being sanctified.
verses.dgt: For by one offering he has perfected for all time those who are being sanctified.

verses.greek: μαρτυρεῖ δὲ ἡμῖν καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, μετὰ γὰρ τὸ εἰρηκέναι·
verses.literal: Bears witness now to us also the Spirit the Holy after for the to have said:
verses.dgt: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

dgt.reason: Human-reviewed full-NT master pass batch 60: δὲ rendered as connective 'And'
Human-reviewed full-NT master pass batch 60: Dative 'to us' belongs with ἡμῖν, not εἰρηκέναι

verses.greek: Αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς,
verses.literal: This is the covenant that I will make with them after the days those says the Lord putting the laws of Mine into the hearts of them and into the mind of them I will inscribe them
verses.dgt: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord: putting my laws on their hearts, I will also write them on their mind,”

verses.greek: καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθήσομαι ἔτι·
verses.literal: and The sins of them and the lawless acts of them certainly not will I remember any more.
verses.dgt: then, “Their sins and their lawless deeds I will certainly remember no more.”

verses.greek: ὅπου δὲ ἄφεσις τούτων, οὐκέτι προσφορὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας.
verses.literal: Where now forgiveness of these is no longer an offering for sin.
verses.dgt: Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer an offering for sin.

verses.greek: Ἔχοντες οὖν, ἀδελφοί, παρρησίαν εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ἰησοῦ,
verses.literal: Having therefore brothers confidence for the entering to the Holy Places by the blood of Jesus
verses.dgt: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence for entrance into the holy places by the blood of Jesus,

verses.greek: ἣν ἐνεκαίνισεν ἡμῖν ὁδὸν πρόσφατον καὶ ζῶσαν διὰ τοῦ καταπετάσματος, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,
verses.literal: which He dedicated for us a way new and living through the veil That is through the flesh of Him
verses.dgt: by the new and living way that he inaugurated for us through the curtain, that is, his flesh,

verses.greek: καὶ ἱερέα μέγαν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ,
verses.literal: and having a priest great over the house the of God
verses.dgt: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

verses.greek: προσερχώμεθα μετὰ ἀληθινῆς καρδίας ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πίστεως, ῥεραντισμένοι τὰς καρδίας ἀπὸ συνειδήσεως πονηρᾶς καὶ λελουσμένοι τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καθαρῷ·
verses.literal: we may draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith sprinkled clean the our hearts from a conscience evil and having ourselves washed the our body with water pure.
verses.dgt: let us approach with a true heart in full assurance of faith, our hearts having been sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our body washed with pure water.

verses.greek: κατέχωμεν τὴν ὁμολογίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἀκλινῆ, πιστὸς γὰρ ὁ ἐπαγγειλάμενος·
verses.literal: We may hold fast to the confession the of our hope firmly faithful for is the One having promised
verses.dgt: Let us hold firmly the confession of hope without wavering, for the one who promised is faithful.

verses.greek: καὶ κατανοῶμεν ἀλλήλους εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων,
verses.literal: And we may think one another toward stirring up to love and to good works
verses.dgt: And let us consider one another so as to provoke love and good works,

verses.greek: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν, καθὼς ἔθος τισίν, ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες, καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε ἐγγίζουσαν τὴν ἡμέραν.
verses.literal: not forsaking the assembling together of ourselves even as is the custom with some but encouraging one another and so much more as much as you see drawing near the Day.
verses.dgt: not abandoning our gathering together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.

verses.greek: Ἑκουσίως γὰρ ἁμαρτανόντων ἡμῶν μετὰ τὸ λαβεῖν τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας, οὐκέτι περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπολείπεται θυσία,
verses.literal: If willingly for sin we after we are the to receive the knowledge of the truth no longer for sins remains a sacrifice
verses.dgt: For if we go on sinning deliberately after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,

verses.greek: φοβερὰ δέ τις ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ πυρὸς ζῆλος ἐσθίειν μέλλοντος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους.
verses.literal: terrifying however a certain expectation of judgment and of fire fury to devour being about the adversaries.
verses.dgt: but a terrifying expectation of judgment and a fury of fire about to consume the adversaries.

verses.greek: ἀθετήσας τις νόμον Μωϋσέως χωρὶς οἰκτιρμῶν ἐπὶ δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν μάρτυσιν ἀποθνῄσκει·
verses.literal: Having set aside anyone the law of Moses without mercies on the basis of two or three witnesses he dies
verses.dgt: Someone who rejected the law of Moses dies without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

verses.greek: πόσῳ δοκεῖτε χείρονος ἀξιωθήσεται τιμωρίας ὁ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καταπατήσας, καὶ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης κοινὸν ἡγησάμενος ἐν ᾧ ἡγιάσθη, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς χάριτος ἐνυβρίσας.
verses.literal: How much think you worse will he deserve punishment the one the Son the of God having trampled upon and the blood of the covenant ordinary having esteemed by which he was sanctified and the Spirit the of grace having insulted?
verses.dgt: How much worse punishment do you think will be deserved by the one who trampled the Son of God underfoot, regarded as common the blood of the covenant by which that person was sanctified, and insulted the Spirit of grace?

verses.greek: οἴδαμεν γὰρ τὸν εἰπόντα· Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις, ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω· καὶ πάλιν· Κρινεῖ κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: We know for the One having said Mine is vengeance I myself will repay and again: Will judge the Lord the people of Him.
verses.dgt: For we know the one who said, “Vengeance is mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

verses.greek: φοβερὸν τὸ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ ζῶντος.
verses.literal: It is a fearful thing the to fall into the hands of God the living.
verses.dgt: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

verses.greek: Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε δὲ τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας, ἐν αἷς φωτισθέντες πολλὴν ἄθλησιν ὑπεμείνατε παθημάτων,
verses.literal: do remember however the former days in which having been enlightened a great conflict you endured of sufferings
verses.dgt: But remember the former days when, after being enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings,

verses.greek: τοῦτο μὲν ὀνειδισμοῖς τε καὶ θλίψεσιν θεατριζόμενοι, τοῦτο δὲ κοινωνοὶ τῶν οὕτως ἀναστρεφομένων γενηθέντες·
verses.literal: this indeed by revilings both and by tribulations being made a spectacle this however partners of those thus passing through them having become
verses.dgt: sometimes being publicly exposed to insults and afflictions, and sometimes becoming partners with those who were treated that way.

verses.greek: καὶ γὰρ τοῖς δεσμίοις συνεπαθήσατε, καὶ τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς προσεδέξασθε, γινώσκοντες ἔχειν ἑαυτοὺς κρείττονα ὕπαρξιν καὶ μένουσαν.
verses.literal: Both for with the prisoners you sympathized and the plundering of the possessions of you with joy you accepted knowing to have yourselves a better possession and abiding.
verses.dgt: For you sympathized with the prisoners and accepted with joy the seizure of your possessions, knowing that you yourselves have a better and lasting possession.

verses.greek: μὴ ἀποβάλητε οὖν τὴν παρρησίαν ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἔχει μεγάλην μισθαποδοσίαν,
verses.literal: Not may throw away therefore the boldness of you which has a great reward.
verses.dgt: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.

verses.greek: ὑπομονῆς γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ἵνα τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ ποιήσαντες κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν·
verses.literal: Of endurance for You have need so that the will the of God having done you may receive the promise.
verses.dgt: For you need endurance so that, after doing the will of God, you may receive the promise.

verses.greek: ἔτι γὰρ μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον, ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ χρονίσει·
verses.literal: Yet for A little very while the One who is coming will come and not will delay.
verses.dgt: For yet “a very little while, and the coming one will come and will not delay.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ δίκαιός μου ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται, καὶ ἐὰν ὑποστείληται, οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: The one however righteous of Mine by faith will live and if he shall shrink back not takes pleasure the soul of Mine in him.
verses.dgt: But my righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, my soul takes no pleasure in him.”

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς εἰς ἀπώλειαν, ἀλλὰ πίστεως εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς.
verses.literal: We ourselves however not are of those drawing back to destruction but of faith to the preserving of the soul.
verses.dgt: But we are not people of shrinking back toward destruction, but of faith toward preserving the soul.
